curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8824-1/ (scans; the hovercraft is pages 1-15, steps 1-20; the helicopter after)

functions.does: The black wheel on top of the cabin steers: an 8 tooth gear at the foot of its shaft turns a 24 tooth gear on the upright steering column at the stern, which swivels the rear wheels below and, through two toothed toggle joints, the propeller above.
functions.source: book: steps 14-15 (the gears, the column and the rear wheels), 20 (black wheel and propeller) and the cover (turning arrows on the black wheel); the propeller swivelling with the column inferred from the model file

functions.does: Rolling the hovercraft on its front wheels spins the propeller: a bevel gear on the front wheels' axle turns a lengthwise shaft, whose crown gear turns an upright shaft with two 16 tooth gears; those drive a chain of 16 tooth clutch gears riding free on the steering knob's shaft and on the steering column, and the last one turns the crown gear on the propeller's shaft.
functions.source: book: steps 9 (front wheels and bevel gears), 13-14 and 17 (16 tooth gears), 20 (propeller with its crown gear) and the cover (turning arrow on the propeller); the gear path inferred from the model file
functions.note: the clutch gears turn freely on their shafts, so the drive passes through the steering column without steering it

functions.does: The two rear wheels roll freely under the steering column.

questions.question: Does the propeller swivel with the steering, like a rudder?
